uz.welcome_message:
🌟 NEXT LEVEL SUPER APP

Sizni korganimizdan xursandmiz! Quyidagi tugmalardan birini tanlang va botning barcha imkoniyatlaridan foydalaning.
uz.guide:
Botdan foydalanish boyicha qollanma:

1. Nick yaratish: Ismingizni yuboring va 100+ xil uslubdagi niklarga ega boling.

2. Anonim xabar: Shaxsiy havolangizni oling va uni kanal yoki guruhlarga ulashing. Dostlaringiz sizga anonim xabarlar yuborishadi.

3. Parol generator: Xavfsiz va kuchli parollar generatsiya qiling.

4. O'yinlar: Eng sara va trenddagi o'yinlarni telegramning ozida o'ynang.

5. Top niklar: Eng mashhur va chiroyli tayyor niklar to'plamini koring.

6. Mashhur stikerlar: Trenddagi stikerlar to'plamidan bahramand boling.

7. Adminga murojaat: Savol yoki takliflar bolsa, Admin tugmasi orqali bizga xabar yuboring.

8. Tilni ozgartirish: Bot tilini o'zingizga qulay tilga ozgartiring.
uz.about: Super App - nicklar, o'yinlar, anonim xabarlar va boshqa imkoniyatlar.

us.welcome_message:
🌟 NEXT LEVEL SUPER APP

Welcome! Please select one of the features below to start.
us.guide:
User Guide:

1. Create Nick: Send your name and get 100+ stylish nicknames.

2. Anonymous Msg: Get your link and share it to receive anonymous messages.

3. Password Generator: Generate strong passwords.

4. Games: Play trending games directly inside Telegram.

5. Top Nicks: See the collection of the most popular nicks.

6. Popular Stickers: Enjoy the trending sticker sets.

7. Contact Admin: Send your questions or suggestions to the admin.

8. Language Settings: Change the bot language anytime.
us.about: Super App - Nickname, Games, Anonymous Messages and more.
